summary: This table presents a financial performance summary comparing key metrics for the years ending December 31, 2024, and December 31, 2023. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, among other financial indicators. Notably, revenues increased by 5.5%, while gross profit saw a growth of 6.3%. Operating profit and net profit also demonstrated positive growth rates of 7.1% and 7.9%, respectively. The table highlights significant increases in basic and diluted earnings per share (EPS), with growth rates of 7.5% and 16.7%, respectively, indicating a strong financial performance year-over-year.
